tick.why: ADRV9361-Z7035 hop port (hopcap adrv9361 profile); branch pin, not for main. tick feat/adrv9361z7035-tick 6d24185 = main 716bd5e plus the Z7035 integration: hdl/projects/adrv9361z7035/ccfmc_lvds/tick_adrv9361z7035_ccfmc_lvds.tcl (scheduler at 0x44AA0000, IRQ ps-14, tick_clk/tick_ctrl_in ports), tick_adrv9361z7035_ctrl_in.xdc and the IOB-register + ad_iobuf CTRL_IN[2:0] block (f95660b). Tick runs at 50 MHz there (clk_wiz from FCLK0 behind an async AXI-Lite converter): with retained-slot repeats the scheduler misses 100 MHz on the Z7035 -2L (OOC WNS -0.27 ns, vrt49's full SFP build -0.38 ns; tick docs/adrv9361z7035-tick.md). Scheduler RTL is unchanged for the ZU11EG profiles (default keeps sys_cpu_clk, timed-dma keeps TICK_TIMEBASE_CLK=core_clk_a); the driver includes 841638f.

vrt49.why: P3b G1 candidate; branch pins, not for main. vrt49 p3b-vrt-dac-tx-switch 0c8764d (PR #91: VRT_DAC_TX_ENABLE=0 keeps the stock TX DMA -> axi_tx_fifo nets), on vrt49 main aec641d. HDL_SHA/CORUNDUM_SHA, linux, ATF and u-boot pins unchanged vs 5e20550; staged IP list unchanged; system_project.tcl now adds opt-in feature CDC XDCs.

labgrid_plugins.why: same pin as vrt49 hw-test.yml (vrt49#87) so hopcap and vrt49 share one runner venv contract; 53f6235 = labgrid-plugins main with the XilinxDeviceJTAG serial fix (#189) plus the artifact-free hw-request
